text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Tokyo Daishoten. Hokko 
Tarumae reaffirms that she runs for 
Tomakomai. And she pledges to shine 
brightly as Tomakomai's star.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Awaiting her were Copano Rickey and Wonder 
Acute. And then—the legendary Umadol, 
Smart Falcon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae was nearly overwhelmed by 
Smart Falcon's sheer presence. However, 
she couldn't afford to lose.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Because they have dreamed of this day for 
so long. At last, their dream... the Tokyo 
Daishoten begins—!!
